tasks.instruction: Recover only the requested model-demand cells: ebit (ebit), revenue (revenue). Required periods: 2027-12-31, 2028-12-31, 2029-12-31. For each visible requested concept, return its exact printed row label, exact period headers, units and only the requested period values in a small grid with cell bboxes. Preserve blanks, dashes, parentheses, signs and footnote markers. Do not transcribe unrelated rows, tables, valuation data, narrative numbers or a whole-page numeric inventory. If none of the requested concepts is visible, return no tables and set surface_disposition to verified_non_tabular with non_tabular_reason 'no requested model-demand concept visible'. Each pass decides independently.

deterministic_steps: Read the hash-bound page image and every supplied region crop.
Use Rogo vision directly, or a registered optional Surya/Docling adapter when the host exposes it; every provider must normalize to the same sealed response contract.
Write two independent grid-preserving responses with different producer fingerprints.
Bind each response to the exact document, surface, image hash and pass index.
Resume the same broker controller transaction without changing source bytes.
